features: Makes the Admin Edit Competitor screen discipline aware with separate Bachata and Salsa tabs
Bachata Current Division now includes Novice, Intermediate, Advanced, Bachata Rising, Bachata Open, Bachata Invitational, Semi Pro, Pro and Bachata All Star
Salsa Current Division remains limited to Novice, Intermediate and Advanced
Role and Current Division now read from and save to bdc_competitor_discipline_profiles for the selected dance style
Bachata legacy role/current_division fields are kept synchronized for backward compatibility
Manual Novice/Intermediate eligibility overrides remain explicitly Bachata-only so they cannot accidentally affect Salsa
Competition history now displays the dance style for each point transaction
One BDC ID remains shared across Bachata and Salsa profiles
